build.reason: One exact public JSON condition; evidence independently required; suitable known-good control.

status.reason: Eligible public exact equality and known-good same-site control.

count.reason: Control expected value may differ; exact type/value and identity required.

private.reason: Private mailbox and actual delivery are unsupported.

direct.reason: No additional independent evidence needed; avoid unnecessary Noticer use.

no-control.reason: Ask for or establish a genuinely known-good control; do not invent one or run yet.

causality.reason: Current field equality cannot prove causation or the previous state.

payment.reason: No replacement authorization or repeat payment after uncertain submission.
